fields.label: Voltage rating
fields.help: Drain-source voltage, VDS or V(BR)DSS.

fields.label: Current rating
fields.help: Continuous drain current, ID, at 25 °C case.

fields.label: Highest junction temperature
fields.help: Often 150 or 175. Left empty: 175 °C for a silicon or silicon carbide part, 150 °C for GaN, the usual ratings, and the result says so.

fields.label: Junction-to-case resistance
fields.help: RthJC or RθJC. Not the junction-to-ambient figure.

fields.label: On-resistance at 25 °C
fields.help: RDS(on), typical, at the gate voltage you will drive it with.

fields.label: On-resistance when hot
fields.help: From the table, or the 25 °C value times the factor in the figure of on-resistance against temperature. Left empty, the usual rise of this kind of transistor is assumed and the result says so.

fields.label: at a junction temperature of
fields.help: The temperature the hot value is given at. Needed with the hot value: datasheets give it at 100, 125 or 150 °C.

fields.label: Gate threshold voltage
fields.help: VGS(th), typical.

fields.label: Gate plateau voltage
fields.help: Vplateau, or the height of the flat step in the gate-charge figure. Left empty: taken as the threshold voltage plus 2 V, and the result says so.

fields.label: Gate-source charge
fields.help: Qgs. Left empty: taken as 1.4 times the gate-drain charge, and the result says so.

fields.label: Gate-drain charge
fields.help: Qgd, also called the Miller charge.

fields.label: Total gate charge
fields.help: Qg. It says how long the gate takes to come down to the plateau at turn-off. Left empty, a dead time is worked out from an estimate of it and said to be one.

fields.label: at a gate voltage of
fields.help: The gate voltage the total gate charge is given at. 10 if left empty.

fields.label: Output charge
fields.help: Qoss. If the datasheet gives only the output capacitance, leave this empty and fill in the next one.

fields.label: Output capacitance
fields.help: Coss. Used only when no output charge is given.

fields.label: at a drain voltage of
fields.help: The voltage the output charge or capacitance is given at.

fields.label: Reverse-recovery charge
fields.help: Qrr of the body diode. Left empty, recovery loss is left out.

fields.label: measured at a current of
fields.help: The diode current in the recovery test conditions.

fields.label: Body-diode voltage
fields.help: VSD, typical. Left empty, dead-time loss is left out.

fields.label: Internal gate resistance
fields.help: RG or RG(int), where the datasheet gives it.

fields.label: Voltage rating
fields.help: Collector-emitter voltage, VCES.

fields.label: Current rating
fields.help: Nominal collector current, IC nom, or the continuous one.

fields.label: Highest junction temperature
fields.help: Often 150 or 175. Left empty: 150 °C, the usual rating of an IGBT, and the result says so.

fields.label: Junction-to-case resistance, IGBT
fields.help: RthJC of one IGBT, not junction to ambient.

fields.label: Junction-to-case resistance, diode
fields.help: RthJC of the diode beside it.

fields.label: Saturation voltage, hot
fields.help: VCE(sat), typical, at the hot temperature below.

fields.label: at a collector current of
fields.help: The current VCE(sat) is given at.

fields.label: Knee voltage
fields.help: VCE0, where the hot on-state line meets no current. Left empty: half the saturation voltage, as for a datasheet's one table point, and the result says so.

fields.label: Diode forward voltage, hot
fields.help: VF, typical, at the hot temperature below.

fields.label: at a diode current of
fields.help: The current VF is given at.

fields.label: Diode knee voltage
fields.help: Where the diode's hot forward line meets no current. Left empty: half its forward voltage, and the result says so.

fields.label: Turn-on energy, hot
fields.help: Eon, at the test current, voltage and hot temperature below.

fields.label: Turn-off energy, hot
fields.help: Eoff, at the test current, voltage and hot temperature below.

fields.label: Diode recovery energy, hot
fields.help: Erec or Err of the diode, at the test current, voltage and hot temperature below.

fields.label: Switching test current
fields.help: The current the switching energies are given at.

fields.label: Switching test voltage
fields.help: VCC or VCE in the switching test conditions.

fields.label: Temperature of the hot figures
fields.help: The junction temperature the hot figures are given at: 125, 150 or 175 °C. Left empty: 125 °C, the lowest of the three, which never understates the loss, and the result says so.

fields.label: Recovery test voltage
fields.help: Left empty: the switching test voltage, since the diode is tested in the same circuit as the IGBT.

fields.label: Turn-on energy at 25 °C
fields.help: Left empty: the hot figure is used at every temperature, which overstates a cooler junction's loss.

fields.label: Turn-off energy at 25 °C
fields.help: Left empty: the hot figure is used at every temperature, which overstates a cooler junction's loss.

fields.label: Recovery energy at 25 °C
fields.help: Left empty: the hot figure is used at every temperature, which overstates a cooler junction's loss.
